description: Two Python update calling conventions and the unknown between them. The two mapping merges are silent because a literal and an annotation positively identify their positional arguments as builtin mappings, even though the receiver came from a call. The ORM near-miss remains reported: the author annotated the receiver QuerySet, the receiver came from filter on a caller-chosen key, and that same key reaches the keyword update. The untyped positional call remains reported below gating because neither its receiver nor its argument says what update means.

expected.note: the caller chooses the queryset key and no owner predicate constrains it
receiver and positional argument unresolved: keep reporting under ADR-003
